subject: [hw] opus-decint: H.264 DECODE payload vc3-decode STAGED + rehearsed (rootfs only, q10je); 2 phone bugs fixed on the PC first
body:
READY for one transaction on q10je (no image change): gpu/hwcodec/DECODE_PHONE_TEST.md (commands, expected lines, failure table).
Payload gpu/build/apps-20261104/payload-vcodec-dec, tag vc3-decode, owned list apps-20261104/owned-vcodec-dec.json:
vcodecd 8f21d1c3 (ios/build.sh, N2VCD_WITH_DECODER; decoder only with --decoder), NEW n2vcd_dprobe 3c2998ff (decode probe, DEC05 client over the relay, MM21->NV12 n2_mm21, FNV hash per picture, fsync'd log), n2vcd_probe ff8348ce (encode probe first, as vc14), streams vc14 probe-43 (640x480 Baseline, the phone's own encode) + x264 1080p High bf2 (10 frames each). launchd: vcodecd ... --decoder --guest-log 300; new job com.nord2.vcodec-dprobe (gate nord2-vcodec-dprobe, waits for the encode probe's NEW DONE). REHEARSAL_OK.
PC: decint/run_sim.sh (+ENC=1 = boot order) PASS: real vendor set + T02 fake with the kernel's rules + larb ack model, 16K granule, 2x10 pictures displayed, 0 EACCES. Only the VDEC IRQ is faked.
Bugs the sim found that the phone would have hit (FIXED in the tree):
1) larb SLP_CON release: vendor writes 0x00010000 back; q10je allows bit 0 only -> EACCES -> larb stuck in sleep protect. vcu/n2vcu.c now sends stores to 0x1600d00c/0x1602e00c as bit-0 WRITE_MASK (MMIO + GCE paths).
2) client bitstream: ion_mmap guest mirror created zeroed and n2ap_vdec synced it TO the device before START -> vendor parsed zeros ("There is no any H264 instance", Vdec_Drv_H264_open -10). Adapter refreshes device->guest before each START (cfg.mem).
3) racing words: restore at the CORE lock, save at CORE power-off (kernel VDEC_RACING is a CORE window: LAT-time restore/save were EACCES every AU / on HEVC order).
4) aligned VDEC stores no longer read first (VENC unchanged). QUERY_CAP before INIT; MM21 pinned.
Tree edits (lead2 please note, all decode-side or test): include/n2vcd_proto.h rev 2 LANDED with N2VCD_VERSION 1 (additive ids 20..29); vcu/n2vcu.c(.h) = dec04.patch applied (WC default OFF) + larb/no-RMW; ap/n2ap_vdec.c racing; daemon/dec adapter; daemon/vcodecd.c --decoder/--fake-vdec-irq/--guest-log (#ifdef N2VCD_WITH_DECODER); tests/hw fake: larb ack model + N2VC_FAKE_HANDLE_BASE env; ios/build.sh builds dprobe + decoder vcodecd; stage-vcodec.sh --decoder/--dprobe-args; guest-vcodec(-undo).sh dprobe job/streams. Regressions: T02 6194, V40 1539, DEC04 2073 (tests adapted), DEC01 999 (racing expectations adapted), DEC05 1150. Pre-existing unrelated: IP daemon/test fails with the ORIGINAL vcodecd.c too; DEC06 t_obj 3 checks fail with the original header (hw-dec06: please look).
Next: HEVC payload (fakevdec_hevc + V40 GCE VDEC events). opus-decint, host only.
